title: Signs in Creation; Every Soul Tastes Death

paragraphs.text: If any of them claimed to be a deity besides Allah, his reward would be Hell. Have the disbelievers not seen that the heavens and earth were joined, and Allah separated them? He made every living thing from water. He set firm mountains on the earth so it would not shift, and made paths between them. He made the sky a protected roof. He created night and day, the sun and the moon, each swimming in its orbit.

No human before lived forever on earth. Every soul will taste death, and Allah tests people with bad and good. When disbelievers see the Prophet, they make fun of him. Man was created hasty, so he should not rush Allah's signs. They ask when the promise will come. If only they knew the time when they cannot push the Fire from their faces or backs! It will come suddenly and confuse them. Messengers before were also mocked, but the mockers were surrounded by what they laughed at.

Who can protect them night or day from the Most Merciful? Their false gods cannot even help themselves. Allah gave them and their fathers good things and long lives. Do they not see the land shrinking at its edges? The deaf do not hear the warning. But if even a breath of punishment touched them, they would cry, "We were wrongdoers!"

hardWords.m: the path something moves on in the sky
make someone unable to think clearly
